name: Auditions for The Lightning Thief Musical
description: Four days of auditions for Pauper Player's annual Spring production of The Lightening Thief: A Percy Jackson Musical! Auditions dates: 12/2, 12/3, 12/4, & 12/5 with a variety of times. Callbacks will be on 12/6. Be sure to sign up using the Signup Genius located in the bio of our Instagram and for more information about the process, come to the informational meeting on 11/22 in FUR-204!

name: Company presented by Pauper Players
description: Company is a musical comedy revolving around Bobby (a single man unable to commit fully to a steady relationship, let alone marriage), the five married couples who are his best friends, and his three girlfriends. Unlike most book musicals, which follow a clearly delineated plot, Company is a concept musical composed of short vignettes, presented in no particular chronological order, linked by a celebration for Bobby's 35th birthday. Seating is limited.
